text.title: Project-Spec Structure Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces is the `.aidocs/project-spec/` tree itself plus a rebuild-test record. The JSON Schema below (draft-07) pins the tree's required shape so an agent can validate it before promoting a feature to done/ or deploying after a CR/BUG fix.

required.field: repo-relative path; `.aidocs/project-spec/` unless constitution.md declares otherwise
the tree is tracked in git, never git-ignored

the twelve flat files named in 05-examples (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, mission.md, glossary.md, business-rules.md, data-model.md, auth.md, deploy.md, config-secrets.md, non-functional.md, observability.md, invariants.md)
`domain/`, `api/`, `integrations/`, `decisions/` — each with its AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md routing pair
the last run: triggering event, pass/fail, and the verbatim assumption list
must be false — no `old/`, no `*-v2.md`, no changelog inside the tree

forbidden.pattern: location is a single .md file rather than a directory (rule r-directory-not-file)
any subdirectory without both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (rule r-subdir-routing-pair)
location under an agent-home directory such as `~/.faion/projects/<name>/` (rule r-canonical-path)
committed = false while the project is shared with multiple people or agents (rule r-canonical-path)
history_in_tree = true — `old/` folders, `*-v2.md` copies or a changelog inside the tree (rule r-current-revision-only)
a nested repo of a multi-repo product carrying its own project-spec/ (rule r-one-spec-per-product)

list.item: The tree lives at `.aidocs/project-spec/` (or the path constitution.md declares) and is committed.
Every subdirectory has AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md before any content file.
Only the current revision of each file is in the tree; history is in git and features/done/.
The rebuild test ran at a delivery event (end-of-feature or post-CR/BUG deploy), and its assumption list contains nothing that affects user-visible behaviour, public API shape, or invariants.
No forbidden pattern matches; the record validates against the schema above.
